description: This file implements the SessionManagementServer class, which manages IPC communication for session management in a media server. It handles server initialization, client connection/disconnection, and server lifecycle control.

classes.name: SessionManagementServer
classes.description: A class that manages IPC server lifecycle, client connections, and logging for session management in a media server environment.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket name and permissions, setting up client connection handlers.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the IPC server event loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the IPC server event loop.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Configures logging levels for different components.

methods.name: onClientConnected
methods.description: Handles new client connections, notifying relevant modules.

methods.name: onClientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnections, notifying relevant modules.
